binding.description: Every required check's evidence must be bound to the exact integration merge SHA of the candidate; a new head/mergeSHA must never reuse an older check's evidence (STALE_EVIDENCE blocks promotion).

requiredChecks.evidenceRule: Protected-check history is preserved; after a restore, old evidence can never authorize a new SHA (infra/delivery/platform/artifact-retention.json#rollbackRetention). QUEUED extends the contract floor for this revision: a check or build that has not finished (queued/in-progress) is never success evidence.
